header.title: Connect an agent
header.subtitle: Give a coding agent on your machine access to this proxy-monster instance over MCP. It signs in as you through OAuth and gets exactly your access.

desktop.title: Proxy Monster Desktop
desktop.body: The menu-bar app for Mac. It signs you in to {instance} and connects Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Codex from its menu.
desktop.notInstalled: Not installed? Download and install it, then click the button again.

agent.title: Paste this to your agent
agent.body: Works in Claude Code and Codex CLI. The agent installs the server; you approve the sign-in in your browser. Pasting it again replaces an earlier install of this instance.
agent.step1: Add an HTTP (streamable HTTP) MCP server named {installName} with the URL {mcpUrl}, in user scope so it is available in every project. If a server named {installName} already exists, replace it.
agent.step2: Start its OAuth login in my browser. In Claude Code, tell me to run /mcp, pick {installName}, and choose Authenticate. No token or password is needed.
agent.after: Once connected, the server describes itself and the datasources I can use.

pmon.title: Already use pmon? Share its login
pmon.body: For an agent on a machine where pmon is installed, including Claude Desktop. The agent runs pmon as a local MCP server and uses your pmon login, so there is no separate sign-in.
pmon.intro: Install the proxy-monster MCP server {installName} through pmon:
pmon.step1: Add a stdio MCP server named {installName} that runs the command `pmon mcp {instance}`, in user scope so it is available in every project. In Claude Desktop, add it to claude_desktop_config.json under mcpServers. If a server named {installName} already exists, replace it.
pmon.step2: If pmon has no server named {instance}, tell me to run `pmon server set {instance} --url {origin}`. If `pmon mcp {instance}` says I am not logged in, tell me to run `pmon login {instance}`.

unsupported.title: Not supported
unsupported.body: claude.ai and ChatGPT connect to remote MCP servers from the vendor's cloud, not from your machine. proxy-monster servers are private and accept connections from your machine only. Claude Desktop works through pmon, above.
